_comment: Copy to .claude/mcleod-ops/sources.json and fill in for your environment. Values written as ${VAR} are read from the environment at run time — keep real addresses and every secret in environment variables, never in this file.

sources._adapter_options: imap | microsoft365 | gmail — use imap when connecting with an app password; use microsoft365/gmail to ride an already-connected MCP connector instead

imap._comment: Used when adapter is 'imap'. Credentials come from the environment; nothing secret belongs in this file.

sources._adapter_options: rest | sql | file_drop — rest uses the McLeod web services API, sql reads a reporting replica, file_drop watches an EDI/export directory

rest._auth_comment: Header names and the exact endpoint paths vary by McLeod release (LoadMaster vs PowerBroker) and by how your instance was provisioned. Confirm all of these against your own McLeod API documentation before enabling — they are placeholders, not verified defaults.

queries.purpose: orders created or updated since the cursor

sql._comment: Used only when adapter is 'sql'. Read-only credentials against a reporting replica.

queries.sql: SELECT id, status, changed_date FROM orders WHERE changed_date > ? ORDER BY changed_date

file_drop._comment: Used only when adapter is 'file_drop'. Directory McLeod exports EDI/CSV into.

escalation._comment: Where the watcher reports things it will not handle on its own.
